S6_no_prior_closure_reopened.notes: The two axes are complementary, not alternatives: an interrogative LEAD is evidence of a question; a first-person past-tense COMPLETION is evidence of an assertion. Dropping on (FIRST_PERSON_COMPLETION) OR (COMPLETION_WORD && !INTERROGATIVE_LEAD) is the obvious strictly-better belt - tested separately, see prepared fix.
